notes.title: N31 Alpha Test Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]
[b]Alpha Test is here![/b][/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/EPQ67RYweE][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XQrLjX3ZamqWjqEy6g/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]We finally did it, we have a playable build.[/h2]
[h3]
Our plan now is to hotfix some of the major issues and release the Alpha build here on Steam!
wanna be part of the alpha test? Join our discord and wait for our live streaming, you might be selected as Alpha tester.[/h3]

[i][u]Alpha Test Keys will be dropped at the end of this month, so activate notifications here and on Discord to keep yourself updated.[/u][/i]

[h1][b][url=https://discord.gg/EPQ67RYweE]Join our Discord Server[/url][/b][/h1]
